output.summary: KEP-1753 proposes a logging filter, integrated with the klog logging library, that redacts sensitive data (tokens, passwords) from Kubernetes system component logs. Sensitive fields would be marked with standard struct tags, and third-party types would be listed centrally.
output.rationale: The Kubernetes Security Audit found bearer tokens and iSCSI cleartext secrets written to system component logs. The audit recommended redacting sensitive information with logging filters, and this KEP implements that recommendation. The filter inspects log entry parameters before the log message is built and redacts entries that may contain sensitive data.

alternatives.option: Rely only on code review policies to prevent dangerous logging actions
alternatives.why_not: The KEP addresses only the redaction-filter part of the audit recommendation; the source does not discuss this option further.

alternatives.option: Attempt to identify all places in the source that store sensitive data
alternatives.why_not: This is a non-goal in the KEP: it does not aim to identify all such places.
